purpose: Exploratory development replay; not accepted warning performance
missingness_treatment: Finite-only per-channel RMS; no interpolation, no concatenation for spectra; retain native row positions and counts
extra_row_treatment: Retain every native row; duration is observed row count divided by documented sample rate; cause unresolved
reference_statistic: median of eligible early-recording RMS for each vibration channel
endpoint: Last acquisition timestamp; descriptive lead only, not verified damage onset or exact stop time
